findings.message: scenario r7_synapse_json__holdout_01: the detection rule expected 1 matches but found 0. 7 document(s) were produced and NOT ONE of them carries any of the fields the rule needs (source.ip, event.action). The mapping may well be right; the parser is not producing these fields. Check `extraction` first - if the layout is wrong, every field is empty and every rule fails regardless of where it is mapped.

scenario r7_synapse_json__holdout_03: the detection rule expected 1 matches but found 0. 7 document(s) were produced and NOT ONE of them carries any of the fields the rule needs (http.response.body.bytes, http.response.status_code). The mapping may well be right; the parser is not producing these fields. Check `extraction` first - if the layout is wrong, every field is empty and every rule fails regardless of where it is mapped.

scenario r7_synapse_json__holdout_04: the detection rule expected 5 matches but found 0. every field the rule needs is present in the documents, so the fields are being produced and the VALUES are landing somewhere unexpected. This is the case where a role is likely wrong: re-check source.* against destination.* against observer.*. the rule looks for http.version = '1.1'; the parsed documents carry 'HTTP/1.1' - if those are the source's words for the same thing, translate them with a value map.

scenario r7_synapse_json__holdout_05: the detection rule expected 3 matches but found 0. the documents carry url.path but never log.logger. Those fields are declared in the mapping and absent from the output, so either the source key does not exist or the extraction is not reaching it.
the probe injected 'Failed password login' as event.action, and it appears in no field of any parsed document. The parser dropped it.

the probe injected '147' as http.response.body.bytes, and it appears in no field of any parsed document. The mapping reads http.response.body.bytes from 'bytes', so that key is not being extracted from the line: check `extraction`.
the probe injected '403' as http.response.status_code, and it appears in no field of any parsed document. The parser dropped it.

the probe injected '1.1' as http.version, and it appears in no field of any parsed document. The mapping reads http.version from 'protocol', so that key is not being extracted from the line: check `extraction`.

the probe injected 'WARNING' as log.level, and it appears in no field of any parsed document. The mapping reads log.level from 'level', so that key is not being extracted from the line: check `extraction`.
the probe injected 'synapse.access.http.8008' as log.logger, but the parser put it in event.module. Whatever the source calls that key, its value is log.logger - that is what the probe did.
the probe injected '::ffff:172.21.90.12' as source.ip, and it appears in no field of any parsed document. The parser dropped it.

the probe injected '@rui:lab.example' as user.id, and it appears in no field of any parsed document. The mapping reads user.id from 'requester', so that key is not being extracted from the line: check `extraction`.
